name: notion
description: Reach Notion from the command line, and publish a code-change explainer as a Notion page.

interface.shortDescription: Notion CLI access and Notion-page explainers.
interface.longDescription: Drives the Notion API through the ntn command line tool: read and search content, create pages, query databases, upload files, and deploy workers. Also publishes an explanation of a diff, branch, or pull request as a native Notion page.
defaultPrompt: Create a Notion page from these notes.
Explain this pull request as a Notion page.
